verdict.rationale: Whether the product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. The only open-source evidence is Vibe, monday's open-source React component library for building apps. That is an adjacent developer building block, not monday.com's own source, so it earns no credit and nothing shows the product itself is open-licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
